summary: Alliance Resource Partners, L.P. (ARLP) filed an 8-K reporting its entry into definitive agreements to acquire the remaining general and limited partner interests in AllDale Minerals III and IV (AllDale III IV) not already owned. The aggregate purchase price is approximately $206.2 million, to be funded with cash on hand and borrowings under a new financing arrangement and existing credit facility. Separately, entities related to CEO Joseph W. Craft III will acquire $100 million of limited partner interests in AllDale III on substantially the same terms. The conflicts committee of ARLP's board, composed of independent directors, reviewed and approved the transactions, deeming them fair and reasonable. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and financing details; the related-party aspect adds governance focus.
